title: Kubedok release manifest
description: Immutable description of one Kubedok suite release. Published by CI only after every image in `images` has been pushed successfully.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this manifest format. setup.sh/update.sh refuse manifests they do not understand.

release.description: Suite release version. All components ship under this one version.

publishedAt.description: UTC timestamp the manifest was published.

gitRevision.description: Commit the images were built from.

images.description: Immutable digest references. Never tags — a tag can be repointed, a digest cannot.

postgresMajor.description: PostgreSQL major version this release expects. A change here is a major-version upgrade and is never performed by update.sh.

minimumAgentVersion.description: Oldest agent version this server release still speaks to. Agents below this must be updated with agent-update.sh.

minimumUpgradeFrom.description: Oldest installed release that may update directly to this one. Older installs must step through an intermediate release.

notes.description: Human-readable release notes URL or short summary.
